en.headline: Arts in the Park returns to Causeway Bay with fairy-tale giant puppets
en.dek: The free two-day youth arts festival at Victoria Park on 14 and 15 November features an illuminated night parade and a finale with ten four-metre puppets.
body: Standard Chartered Arts in the Park will return to Victoria Park in Causeway Bay on 14 and 15 November for its largest edition to date, organised by the Hong Kong Youth Arts Foundation.

This year’s programme centres on classic fairy tales and includes an illuminated night parade on the evening of 14 November starting at 8:30pm from the main entrance of Lee Garden One, featuring five giant lantern puppets and 18 carnival costumes by local artists.

The grand finale parade on 15 November begins at 2:30pm in Victoria Park and proceeds through Causeway Bay streets, with a procession of about 500 participants, 400 costumes and ten four-metre-tall giant puppets.

During both days from 10am to 5pm, the central lawn of Victoria Park will host 17 interactive arts booths, live stage performances, storytelling sessions, African drumming workshops and an exhibition of more than 900 artworks created by local students. Admission is free.

zh.headline: 渣打藝趣嘉年華重返銅鑼灣 童話巨型木偶亮相維園
zh.dek: 11月14及15日免費兩日青年藝術節於維多利亞公園舉行，包括夜間燈飾巡遊及十個四米高巨型木偶壓軸巡遊。
body: 渣打藝趣嘉年華將於11月14及15日重返銅鑼灣維多利亞公園，由香港青年藝術協會主辦，是歷來規模最大的一屆。
今年以經典童話為主題。11月14日晚上8時30分，由利園一期正門起步的夜間燈飾巡遊將有五個巨型燈籠木偶及18套本地藝術家設計的嘉年華服飾。
15日下午2時30分，壓軸巡遊從維園出發，約500人參與，配有400套服飾及十個四米高巨型木偶，沿銅鑼灣街道遊行。
兩日上午10時至下午5時，維園中心草坪設有17個互動藝術攤位、舞台表演、說故事環節、非洲鼓工作坊，以及超過900件本地學生藝術作品展覽。入場免費。
